Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human adenosine A2a receptor. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter by target name 'Adenosine A2a receptor' and organism 'Homo sapiens'. Return molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
